top_stories.title: Congress workers seek Cabinet berth for Belur Gopala Krishna - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **B.R. Jayanth**, a senior Congress leader, urged the party's high command to appoint **Belur Gopala Krishna**, a Congress MLA for Sagar and Belur, to the Karnataka State Cabinet.  Jayanth argued that Gopala Krishna, who has been elected three times, deserves an opportunity similar to **Madhu Bangarappa**, who served as Minister for Education for three years.

top_stories.title: Shivamogga Muslim Rights Forum seeks DCM post for Zameer Ahmed Khan - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Members of the Muslim community** gathered in Shivamogga, India, to urge the **Congress party** to appoint former minister Zameer Ahmed Khan as Deputy Chief Minister. The protesters emphasized Khan's contributions to the party and his efforts to promote social justice, communal harmony, and support for marginalized groups during his time as a minister.

top_stories.title: Poll battle among rich - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Govindaraju**, a candidate from the **Janata Dal (Secular)**, is the wealthiest contender in the upcoming Legislative Council election with total assets of ₹173.69 crore. His rival, **Vinay Karthik**, grandson of former Congress leader **Sahukar Chennaiah**, has assets worth ₹106.96 crore.  **P.V. Mohan**, a candidate from the Congress, declared assets worth ₹75.50 lakh.

top_stories.title: Solar firms move Karnataka HC over “unreasonable” domestic-cell mandate - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **KRESMA**, a group of solar manufacturers and developers, has filed a petition in the **Karnataka High Court** to delay a new rule requiring most new solar projects to use domestically made cells. The petitioners argue that the price difference between Indian-made and imported solar cells is significant, with domestic prices around ₹13 per watt compared to international prices of about ₹5 per watt.

top_stories.title: Akhilesh spreading ‘fabricated lies’ about Ram temple, says BJP - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Akhilesh Yadav**, president of the **Samajwadi Party**, accused **Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust** general secretary **Champat Rai** of mismanaging donations to the **Ram Temple** in Ayodhya.  **Rai** refuted these claims, stating that an internal audit is underway and has not revealed any irregularities. The **BJP** criticized **Yadav** for spreading "fabricated lies" with potential political consequences ahead of the 2027 state elections.

top_stories.title: Trinamool rebellion revives government hopes of passing Delimitation Bill - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Trinamool Congress** internal dissent, particularly within its parliamentary party, has reignited speculation about the government's potential introduction of the Delimitation Bill during the Monsoon Session in mid-July. The bill, aimed at redrawing electoral boundaries based on the 2011 census, failed to secure a two-thirds majority in Parliament in April and was accompanied by the Women’s Reservation Amendment Bill, which also fell short.

top_stories.title: Not named NDA nominee for Bihar Council poll, RLM chief’s son set to lose Cabinet berth - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Upendra Kushwaha**, leader of the **Rashtriya Lok Morcha (RLM)**, and his son, **Deepak Prakash**, who serves as Panchayati Raj Minister in the Bihar government, were not among the nine candidates nominated by the ruling **National Democratic Alliance (NDA)** for the June 18 Legislative Council election.  Mr. Prakash must be elected to either House of the Legislature within six months to retain his Cabinet position, but there is no vacancy in the Council until March 2027.

top_stories.title: Ex-CIA officer accused of siphoning $40 million in gold bars claimed it was for 'government operations' - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: A former **CIA** officer, David Rush, is accused of stealing over $40 million worth of gold bars and foreign currency using a fake "special access program".  Rush created the program to conceal his actions and avoid scrutiny, involving colleagues in the scheme. The **CIA** and **FBI** are investigating the case after an internal investigation revealed potential violations of law. Rush has been charged with theft of public money and faces additional allegations of creating false credentials for government positions.

top_stories.title: How Lebanon became the breaking point for the Iran war ceasefire | Israel attacks Lebanon News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Iran** launched its first direct strikes on **Israel** in two months, escalating tensions after weeks of warnings about continued Israeli attacks on Lebanon. The **IRGC** stated that the attacks were a warning and further Israeli aggression would be met with broader retaliation against all American-Zionist targets.  The US president expressed concern over the escalation but called for both sides to cease fire. While a ceasefire agreement was reached in April, Israel's continued military operations have raised concerns about the possibility of a lasting peace deal between **Iran** and the US.

top_stories.title: Bombay HC quashes Union Cabinet decisions imposing retrospective spectrum charge on Airtel, Vodafone Idea | Business News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Omkar Gokhale**, a journalist for **The Indian Express**, provides in-depth coverage of legal and judicial developments in Maharashtra, focusing on the Bombay High Court and Supreme Court. His expertise lies in reporting on cases involving fundamental rights, environment, civil and criminal law, constitutional matters, and governance issues.  Gokhale's work is recognized as authoritative due to his affiliation with **The Indian Express**, a reputable national newspaper known for its rigorous journalistic standards.
